source.author: cic
source.text: quid, cum coram sumus et garrimus quicquid in buccam?
source.text_original: quid, cum coram sumus et garrimus quicquid in buccam?
source.text_english: What about when we are together face to face and chatter whatever comes into our mouths?

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: unde accidit, ut omissa compositione uerborum et scribentium sollicitudine dictem, quicquid in buccam uenerit, et amicum te tantum meorum dictorum, non iudicem considerem.
reuse.text_original: unde accidit, ut omissa compositione uerborum et scribentium sollicitudine dictem, quicquid in buccam uenerit, et amicum te tantum meorum dictorum, non iudicem considerem.
reuse.text_english: Hence it comes about that, with the arrangement of words and the care of writers laid aside, I speak whatever comes into my mouth, and consider you only as a friend of my words, not a judge.
